/faq: Frequently Asked Questions

DarGlobal creates luxury properties and branded residences that blend lifestyle, design, and long-term value. Through global partnerships and meticulous craftsmanship, we deliver premium homes and communities built with integrity and purpose — offering investors a sense of belonging, measurable value, and a legacy that lasts.
Why invest with DarGlobal?
DarGlobal is built for a new kind of global investor - one who values not just ROI, but ROE and ROL.
What's ROI, ROE and ROL?

ROI (Return on Investment) : measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation. ROE (Return on Ego) : the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for. ROL (Return on Legacy) : the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow. We see the world as one connected home — where value is something you live, not just measure. Our community of investors, partners, and visionaries builds with purpose and pride. With DarGlobal, every investment becomes a lasting mark of trust, identity, and inheritance for the future.
What makes DarGlobal different?

We work with clarity, purpose, and collaboration — turning global partnerships into lasting opportunity. Guided by over three decades of experience, every development reflects trusted execution and measurable value.
Where does DarGlobal operate?
Across 14 cities in 9 countries, including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives.
What types of properties do you offer?
We develop residences, cities, and hospitality projects in the world’s most dynamic destinations. Each one is designed as both a home to live in and an investment to grow.
Why partner with global brands?

They deliver something rare — ROE (Return on Ego): the pride of owning what few can, and the distinction of belonging to a world defined by rarity, scarcity, and status. Each collaboration is designed to create an asset of identity and desire.
Can international buyers invest?
Yes. DarGlobal is built for the global citizen — our destinations welcome international investors with full ownership rights, residency privileges, and secure, transparent investment frameworks.
How does the buying process work?
Select your property, consult our advisors, reserve securely, and complete your purchase digitally or through our global offices.
Investing with DarGlobal
Experience smart global investing with DarGlobal — from Dubai to London, discover curated opportunities in world-class developments.
How can I invest in DarGlobal properties?

Investing with DarGlobal is designed to be seamless and global. Choose a project, speak with our advisors, and secure your unit digitally or through any of our international offices. Whether you live in Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Muscat, Doha, London, Marbella, or New York — your investment journey begins wherever you are.
What are the benefits of investing in off-plan luxury properties?

Off-plan at DarGlobal means entering early into high-growth destinations, benefiting from attractive prices, flexible payment plans, and the appreciation that comes with world-class design and brand collaborations. It’s not just smart investing — it’s securing future value today.
Are DarGlobal projects suitable for international investors?

Absolutely. DarGlobal is built for global citizens. Our destinations offer secure frameworks, full ownership rights, residency benefits, and a transparent buying process — making international investment simple, strategic, and protected.
What kind of returns can I expect?

Each development is strategically positioned for capital appreciation and strong rental yields. From premium Dubai residences to branded Marbella villas and waterfront Muscat properties, returns grow as the cities grow — delivering ROI, ROE, and ROL.
Is my investment with DarGlobal secure and transparent?

Yes. With over three decades of delivery, DarGlobal is anchored in trust, clarity, and transparent processes. Every investor is protected by local regulations, escrow systems, and our global partnerships — ensuring peace of mind at every step.

Discover what makes our luxury properties and iconic collaborations truly exceptional worldwide.
/why-invest: EXPAND YOUR WORLD. GROW YOUR WEALTH.

DarGlobal develops premium real estate for global citizens who seek elevated living and enduring value. From branded residences to resort-style retreats, every project offers luxurious design and real-life amenities. All in coveted locations with smart investment potential.
Investing in real estate unlocks more than a home. Discover the freedom to live anywhere. Tax benefits. Long-term stability. Strategic investment opens doors to new possibilities.
Saudi Arabia: Residency Through Investment
Invest 4M SAR (Approx 1.07M USD) to secure Saudi residency and its exclusive benefits.
Enjoy a 30-year corporate tax exemption, ensuring long-term financial advantages.
The Saudi Riyal (SAR) is pegged to USD, offering currency stability for investors.
Investors can now open a bank account in Saudi Arabia while on a visit visa.
Oman: Lifetime Residency for Investors
Invest in real estate and obtain lifetime residency.
Hassle-free bank account setup for investors.
0% Personal income tax ensures greater financial gains.
0% Import or export duties, making business operations seamless.
Qatar: A Gateway to Prosperity
No personal income tax and no property tax, maximizing returns. Competitive corporate tax rates make Qatar an attractive business hub.
Obtain permanent residency by investing 3,650,000 QAR (1 million USD), providing long-term residency and access to Qatar’s benefits.
Investor Visa Program

Offers residency to investors who purchase real estate in Qatar with a minimum investment of 728,000 QAR (200,000 USD). Upon confirmation of payment, the Ministry of Justice issues a Sanad Mabdayi, a temporary title deed recognizing ownership. This enables investors to apply for residency even before project completion, under the new government-approved framework.
United Arab Emirates (UAE): 10-Year Golden Visa
Invest 2 million AED (Approx 545,000 USD) in real estate, now including off-plan properties, to obtain a 10-year Golden Visa.
Invest wisely and unlock the benefits of residency in these thriving economies.

Ras Al Khaimah is the UAE’s next move. Just an hour from Dubai, it offers space to breathe, 64 km of coast to explore, and a pace that’s yours to set. With its natural beauty and growing economy, it’s a place to live well. And watch your wealth grow. DarGlobal’s thoughtfully designed properties offer an accessible entry point to RAK with steep returns for savvy investors.
Introduction to Ras Al Khaimah (RAK)

Strategically positioned at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, and Africa, RAK International Airport is just a four-hour flight from one-third of the global population and only 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport.
Known for its economic diversification, RAK is less reliant on oil, with no single sector contributing more than 30% to the GDP.
Etihad Rail Connectivity: set to launch in 2026, the national high-speed rail network will link RAK to Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and the wider GCC region.
RAK’s GDP is projected to grow by more than 4% annually in 2025-2027.
Ras Al Khaimah's real estate market surged over 850% in transaction values from Q1 2017 to Q1 2025, reaching AED 13.06 billion ($3.56 billion) in Q1 alone.
RAK welcomed over 1.28 million visitors in 2024, a 5% increase from 2023.
Al Marjan Island is set to become a major tourism hub with projects like the Wynn Integrated Resort and other developments by major hotel brands.
Al Marjan Island offers attractive returns, with rental yields exceeding 9%, peaking at 11-12% for branded residences & short-term holiday homes.
Potential to generate yields beyond 9% – outpacing Dubai's 6-8% beachfront averages.

Al Marjan Island has sold out of available land, meaning no further development can occur. This limited supply, combined with growing demand, results in high appreciation potential for existing properties.
The opening of the Wynn Resort in 2027, featuring the first casino in the Middle East, is expected to significantly boost tourism and demand, leading to increased ROI for short-term rentals.
Projects by leading developers and brands like Emaar, Aldar, Nobu, and Elie Saab include luxury residential units and resorts.
Key Investment Areas: Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, and Al Hamra Village are in high demand for their luxury residential and commercial properties

/tokenization: With tokenization, DarGlobal is future-proofing real estate investment for discerning investors. This is how you invest differently.
Tokenization: Investing in the Future, Today

DarGlobal is evolving how the world invests in luxury real estate. Through blockchain-powered tokenization, we’re making access to high-value properties smarter, more flexible, and globally connected.
What Does This Mean for You?
We’re turning physical assets into digital tokens - fractional shares of our premium properties that investors can buy, sell, or hold. This opens the door to new opportunities:
Invest in DarGlobal’s most exclusive projects from anywhere in the world.
Liquidity with Confidence: Trade your tokens through regulated platforms while knowing you’re backed by real-world assets.
Security & Transparency: Every transaction is recorded on a secure blockchain, ensuring full visibility and trust.
Fractional Ownership: Own a share of luxury residences without the complexity of traditional real estate deals.
Why Tokenization with DarGlobal? We deliver real investments with real returns. Tokenization is a new key unlocking smarter, more agile ownership models.
It’s not about trends, it’s about expanding your portfolio. It’s not about crypto hype, it’s about enhancing liquidity. It’s not about making noise, it’s about giving global citizens more control.
